SELECT ACID, COUNT(*) FROM d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE GROUP BY ACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

SELECT file_name, * FROM d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE EOD_DATE > LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)

SELECT FILE_NAME, EOD_DATE, END_EOD_DATE, LCHG_TIME, RCRE_TIME, * FROM d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE ACID = 'PA10105' ORDER BY 2 DESC
